primaryChecks.text: Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him: Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Jeroboam didn’t recover strength again in the days of Abijah. The LORD struck him, and he died.
